-- TempDB 공간 확인 변수
DECLARE @TempDBSizeMB FLOAT
DECLARE @TempDBFreeSpaceMB FLOAT
DECLARE @TempDBFreeSpacePercent FLOAT
DECLARE @UseSortInTempDB NVARCHAR(10) = 'ON' -- 기본값

-- 변수 선언
DECLARE @SchemaName NVARCHAR(128)
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(128)
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME
DECLARE @EndTime DATETIME
DECLARE @ElapsedTime INT

-- 처리할 테이블이 있는 동안 루프
WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TableList WHERE Processed = 0)
BEGIN
    -- 처리할 테이블 선택
    SELECT TOP 1 @TableName = TableName 
    FROM @TableList 
    WHERE Processed = 0
    ORDER BY TableName

    -- 테이블의 스키마 이름 확인
    SELECT TOP 1 @SchemaName = SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)
    FROM sys.tables
    WHERE name = @TableName

    -- TempDB 공간 확인
    SELECT 
        @TempDBSizeMB = SUM(size) / 128.0,
        @TempDBFreeSpaceMB = SUM(size) / 128.0 - SUM(FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed')) / 128.0
    FROM sys.master_files
    WHERE database_id = DB_ID('tempdb') AND type = 0
    
    SET @TempDBFreeSpacePercent = (@TempDBFreeSpaceMB / @TempDBSizeMB) * 100
    
    PRINT 'TempDB Total Size: ' + CAST(@TempDBSizeMB AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' MB'
    PRINT 'TempDB Free Space: ' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpaceMB AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' MB (' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpacePercent AS VARCHAR(20)) + '%)'
    
    -- TempDB 여유 공간에 따른 SORT_IN_TEMPDB 동적 설정
    IF @TempDBFreeSpacePercent < 10
    BEGIN
        SET @UseSortInTempDB = 'OFF'
        PRINT 'TempDB free space is below 10%. Using SORT_IN_TEMPDB = OFF'
        
        -- 로그 파일 축소 시도
        PRINT 'Attempting to shrink log file...'
        BEGIN TRY
            DBCC SHRINKFILE (2, 512)  -- 파일 ID 2는 일반적으로 TempDB 로그 파일
            PRINT 'TempDB log file shrink attempted.'
            
            -- 축소 후 공간 다시 확인
            SELECT 
                @TempDBSizeMB = SUM(size) / 128.0,
                @TempDBFreeSpaceMB = SUM(size) / 128.0 - SUM(FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed')) / 128.0
            FROM sys.master_files
            WHERE database_id = DB_ID('tempdb') AND type = 0
            
            SET @TempDBFreeSpacePercent = (@TempDBFreeSpaceMB / @TempDBSizeMB) * 100
            PRINT 'After shrink - TempDB Free Space: ' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpaceMB AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' MB (' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpacePercent AS VARCHAR(20)) + '%)'
            
            -- 공간이 회복되면 SORT_IN_TEMPDB 다시 ON
            IF @TempDBFreeSpacePercent >= 10
        BEGIN
            SET @UseSortInTempDB = 'ON'
            PRINT 'TempDB space recovered. Using SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ON'
        END
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            PRINT 'Error shrinking TempDB log file: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
        END CATCH
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @UseSortInTempDB = 'ON'
        PRINT 'Using SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ON'
    END
    
    -- TempDB 여유 공간이 3% 미만이면 작업 중단 (안전 마진)
    IF @TempDBFreeSpacePercent < 3
    BEGIN
        PRINT 'TempDB free space is below 3%. Stopping execution to prevent disk full.'
        BREAK
    END
    
    SET @StartTime = GETDATE()
    
    -- 테이블별 인덱스 REBUILD 명령문 생성 (ONLINE OFF, MAXDOP 8, SORT_IN_TEMPDB 동적)
    SET @sql = 'ALTER INDEX ALL ON [' + @SchemaName + '].[' + @TableName + '] ' +
               'REBUILD WITH (ONLINE = OFF, MAXDOP = 8, ' +
               'SORT_IN_TEMPDB = ' + @UseSortInTempDB + ', ' +
               'STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF)'
    
    PRINT 'Start rebuilding ALL indexes on table: ' + @SchemaName + '.' + @TableName
    PRINT 'Command: ' + @sql
    PRINT 'Start time: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @StartTime, 120)

    INSERT INTO DROP_PLOG([PGM_NM],[TBL_NM],[MSG])
    VALUES('0_3RD_REBUILD_INDEX_SCP_CUTOFF_36_TABLES.REBUILD_INDEX_BY_TABLE',@TableName,@sql);
    
    -- 실행
    BEGIN TRY
        EXEC sp_executesql @sql
        SET @EndTime = GETDATE()
        SET @ElapsedTime = DATEDIFF(SECOND, @StartTime, @EndTime)
        PRINT 'All indexes rebuilt successfully. Elapsed time: ' + CAST(@ElapsedTime AS VARCHAR) + ' seconds'
        
        -- 현재 테이블 처리 완료 표시
        UPDATE @TableList SET Processed = 1 WHERE TableName = @TableName
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT 'Error rebuilding indexes on ' + @TableName + ': ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
        
        -- 오류 발생 시 TempDB 공간 다시 확인
        SELECT 
            @TempDBFreeSpaceMB = SUM(size) / 128.0 - SUM(FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed')) / 128.0
        FROM sys.master_files
        WHERE database_id = DB_ID('tempdb') AND type = 0
        
        SET @TempDBFreeSpacePercent = (@TempDBFreeSpaceMB / @TempDBSizeMB) * 100
        PRINT 'TempDB Free Space after error: ' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpaceMB AS VARCHAR(20)) + ' MB (' + CAST(@TempDBFreeSpacePercent AS VARCHAR(20)) + '%)'
        
        -- TempDB 여유 공간이 3% 미만이면 작업 중단
        IF @TempDBFreeSpacePercent < 3
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'TempDB free space is below 3% after error. Stopping execution.'

            INSERT INTO DROP_PLOG([PGM_NM],[TBL_NM],[MSG])
            VALUES('Error_0_0_REBUILD_INDEX_SCP_CUTOFF_36_TABLES.REBUILD_INDEX_BY_TABLE',@TableName,@sql);

            BREAK
        END
        
        -- 실패한 테이블은 건너뛰고 다음으로
        UPDATE @TableList SET Processed = 1 WHERE TableName = @TableName
    END CATCH
    
    -- CHECKPOINT 실행
    PRINT 'Executing CHECKPOINT...'
    CHECKPOINT
    
    -- 10초 대기
    PRINT 'Waiting for 10 seconds...'
    WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:10'
    
    PRINT '--------------------------------------------------'
    
    -- 루프 종료 조건 확인
    IF @TempDBFreeSpacePercent < 3
        BREAK
END

PRINT 'Index rebuild process completed.'

--
--CUTOFF 포함되어 있으면 아래 반드시 실행해야한다.
--

/* 1. 그룹 개수 지정 */
DECLARE @GroupCount INT = 1;  -- 원하는 그룹 개수 (예: 2, 4, 5)

/* 2. 그룹 상태 테이블 준비 */
DECLARE @Groups TABLE
(
    GroupNo INT PRIMARY KEY,
    TotalMinutes INT
);

DECLARE @i INT = 1;
WHILE @i <= @GroupCount
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO @Groups (GroupNo, TotalMinutes) VALUES (@i, 0);
    SET @i += 1;
END

/* 3. 기존 그룹 정보 초기화 */
UPDATE dbo.NERP_CONV_CUTOFF_TAKES_MIN
SET GROUP_NUM = NULL,
    GROUP_COUNT = @GroupCount
WHERE RTYPE =N'DM';

/* 4. Greedy 방식 분배 */
DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(128), @Minutes INT, @TargetGroup INT;

DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR
    SELECT TABLE_NAME, AVG
    FROM dbo.NERP_CONV_CUTOFF_TAKES_MIN
    WHERE RTYPE =N'DM'
    ORDER BY AVG DESC;   -- 소요시간 큰 것부터 배정

OPEN cur;
FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @TableName, @Minutes;

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
    -- 현재 합계가 가장 작은 그룹 선택
    SELECT TOP 1 @TargetGroup = GroupNo
    FROM @Groups
    ORDER BY TotalMinutes ASC;

    -- 해당 테이블에 그룹번호 업데이트
    UPDATE dbo.NERP_CONV_CUTOFF_TAKES_MIN
    SET GROUP_NUM = @TargetGroup,
        GROUP_COUNT = @GroupCount,
        LAST_UPDATE_DATE = GETDATE()
    WHERE RTYPE =N'DM' AND TABLE_NAME = @TableName;

    -- 그룹 합계 갱신
    UPDATE @Groups
    SET TotalMinutes = TotalMinutes + @Minutes
    WHERE GroupNo = @TargetGroup;

    FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @TableName, @Minutes;
END

CLOSE cur;
DEALLOCATE cur;

DECLARE @MESSAGE		NVARCHAR(MAX)

WHERE 1 = 1

	WHERE PLAN_NAME = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112)

DECLARE @CHK_ITVL					NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @SMS_ITVL					NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @LAST_HEALTH_CHECK_TIME		NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @LAST_SMS_SEND_TIME			NVARCHAR(50)

SELECT	  
		TOP 1 
			  @CHK_ITVL					= B.SEGMENT1 
			, @SMS_ITVL					= B.SEGMENT2 
			, @LAST_HEALTH_CHECK_TIME	= B.ATTRIBUTE1 
			, @LAST_SMS_SEND_TIME		= B.ATTRIBUTE2 
FROM SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER  AS A
	JOIN SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  AS B WITH(NOLOCK)
	ON	A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
WHERE	A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_JOB_MGR_MNTR'
AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'

IF DATEDIFF(SECOND,IIF(ISNULL(@LAST_HEALTH_CHECK_TIME,'')='',GETDATE()-1,@LAST_HEALTH_CHECK_TIME),GETDATE()) >= (@CHK_ITVL * 60) - 10  -- 설정된 CHK_ITVL 보다 크면 수행/ 1분주기가 1분주기 정상수행을 위해 10초 뺌
BEGIN

	-- 점검 시간 업데이트
	UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
		SET ATTRIBUTE1 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),GETDATE(),120)
	WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_JOB_MGR_MNTR'

	-- 설정된 시간안에 문자발송 이력이 있으면 전송안함.
	IF DATEDIFF(SECOND,IIF(ISNULL(@LAST_SMS_SEND_TIME,'')='',GETDATE()-1,@LAST_SMS_SEND_TIME),GETDATE()) >= (@SMS_ITVL * 60) - 10  -- 설정된 SMS_ITVL 보다 크면 수행/ 1분주기가 1분주기 정상수행을 위해 10초 뺌
	BEGIN
	
		-- 발송 대상 찾기.
		DECLARE @PROG_NM NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		SELECT @PROG_NM = STRING_AGG(PROGRAM_NAME,',') FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PROGRAM_NAME 
			FROM SCP_JOB_MANAGER_HEALTHY_M WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE 1 = 1 
			AND HEALTHY_DATE_TIME	>=  DATEADD(DAY,-3,GETDATE()) -- 3일 이상 지난것 문자발송 대상 제외
			AND PROGRAM_NAME		IN 
			(
				'JobManager_LoadBalancer',
				'JobManager_SCP'
			)
			AND DATEDIFF(SECOND,HEALTHY_DATE_TIME,GETDATE())  > 300 -- 1분 고정. -- 20260921 1분 ->5분 변경
			GROUP BY PROGRAM_NAME 
		) AS LIST

		IF ISNULL(@PROG_NM,'') <> ''
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @MESSAGE NVARCHAR(MAX)

			SET @MESSAGE = @PROG_NM 		

			-- 문자발송 시간 업데이트
			UPDATE SCP_OPMZ_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
				SET ATTRIBUTE2 = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),GETDATE(),120)
			WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_OPT_ENG_JOB_MGR_MNTR'

			EXEC SCM_ADM_SMS_SEND_BATCH 107, @message --- 107 OPT_ENGINE_HEALTH_MONITOR 수신대상 세팅

		END
	END
END

DECLARE @return_value int

DECLARE @v_company_id   nvarchar(10)
DECLARE @v_yyyymm   nvarchar(10)
DECLARE @v_nerp_gubun   nvarchar(10)

      SET @v_yyyymm = CONVERT(CHAR(6),GETDATE(),112); -- 당월

      DECLARE PLANT_TEMP CURSOR FOR	  
		SELECT plant_id, company_id, nerp_gubun
		FROM  (
				SELECT scp.segment3 AS plant_id, scp.attribute4 company_id, scp.segment5  nerp_gubun
					 , ISNULL(fp.START_TIME, '07')    AS START_TIME -- Local 기준 시업시간
					 , ISNULL(fp.LOCAL_HH23, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 2))    AS LOCAL_HH23   -- Local 기준 시업시간 / -- 조회 시점 Local 시간
					 , SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 2) AS KST -- 조회 시점 한국 시간
					 , '====' AS GUBUN
					 , ISNULL(fp.START_TIME_MI, '073') AS START_TIME_MI, ISNULL(fp.LOCAL_HH23MI, '073') AS LOCAL_HH23MI -- Local 기준 시업시간/분 / -- 조회 시점 Local 시간/분
					 , SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 3) AS KSTMI -- 조회 시점 한국 시간/분
				FROM   scm_adm_lookup_master_detail scp WITH(NOLOCK)

				  LEFT JOIN (SELECT   SITE_ID, P.PLANT_ID
									, VL.SEGMENT2, SUBSTRING(VL.SEGMENT2,1,3) AS START_TIME_MI -- Local 기준 시업시간/분
									, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), [dbo].[FN_SITE_TIME_SN] (P.SITE_ID), 120),':', ''), 12, 3) AS LOCAL_HH23MI -- 조회 시점 Local 시간/분 : LGCE_FPDEV_TR.[dbo].[FN_SITE_TIME]
									, SUBSTRING(VL.SEGMENT2,1,2) AS START_TIME -- Local 기준 시업시간
									, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), [dbo].[FN_SITE_TIME_SN] (P.SITE_ID), 120),':', ''), 12, 2) AS LOCAL_HH23 -- 조회 시점 Local 시간
					
							FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN  VL WITH(NOLOCK),
									SCM_MST_PLANT_SN         P  WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE  VL.SEGMENT1         = P.PLANT_ID
							AND    VL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT'
							AND    VL.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
						   ) fp
				   ON  scp.segment3 = fp.PLANT_ID -- Plant ID

				WHERE  scp.lookup_type = 'ERP_POSTING_STOCK_SETUP'
				--AND    scp.segment4    = 'A' -- plant 분리 실행 시 주석 제거
                AND    segment5   <> '-'
				AND    scp.valid_yn    = 'Y'
			  ) a
		WHERE  a.START_TIME = a.LOCAL_HH23 -- 시업시간에 수행
		ORDER BY 1;

        --SELECT segment3, attribute4
        --FROM   scm_adm_lookup_master_detail WITH(NOLOCK)
        --WHERE  lookup_type = 'ERP_POSTING_STOCK_SETUP'
        ----AND    segment4    = 'A' -- plant 분리 실행 시 주석 제거
        --AND    valid_yn    = 'Y'
        --ORDER BY 1;
	  
        OPEN PLANT_TEMP;
        FETCH NEXT FROM PLANT_TEMP INTO @v_plant_id, @v_company_id, @v_nerp_gubun
		 
        WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
        BEGIN

          IF @v_nerp_gubun = 'G'
          BEGIN

            EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[PR_SCM_SYS_RFC_CALL]
                 @p_param1 = N'XIF_ERP_ZMM_GSCM_END_STOCK_R'
                ,@p_param2 = @v_company_id
                ,@p_param3 = @v_plant_id
                ,@p_param4 = @v_yyyymm
        
          END

          ELSE
          BEGIN
		  
            EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[PR_SCM_SYS_RFC_CALL_NERP]
                 @p_param1 = N'XIF_ERP_ZMM_GSCM_END_STOCK_R'
                ,@p_param2 = @v_company_id
                ,@p_param3 = @v_plant_id
                ,@p_param4 = @v_yyyymm

          END 

	        -- 수신 정보 처리 Call
            EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[PR_SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R_D]

          FETCH NEXT FROM PLANT_TEMP INTO @v_plant_id, @v_company_id, @v_nerp_gubun
        END
		
      CLOSE PLANT_TEMP;
      DEALLOCATE PLANT_TEMP; 	  

SELECT 'Return Value' = @return_value

GO

DECLARE @RETURN_VALUE	INT
DECLARE @V_PLANT_ID		NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @V_COMPANY_ID   NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @V_YYYYMM		NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @V_NERP_GUBUN   NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @MESSAGE		NVARCHAR(200)

SET @V_YYYYMM = CONVERT(CHAR(6),GETDATE(),112); -- 당월

DECLARE PLANT_TEMP CURSOR FOR	  

SELECT 
	  PLANT_ID, COMPANY_ID, NERP_GUBUN 
FROM  (
		SELECT SCP.SEGMENT3 AS PLANT_ID, SCP.ATTRIBUTE4 COMPANY_ID, SCP.SEGMENT5  NERP_GUBUN
				, ISNULL(FP.START_TIME, '07')    AS START_TIME -- LOCAL 기준 시업시간
				, ISNULL(FP.LOCAL_HH23, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 2))    AS LOCAL_HH23   -- LOCAL 기준 시업시간 / -- 조회 시점 LOCAL 시간
				, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 2) AS KST -- 조회 시점 한국 시간
				, '====' AS GUBUN
				, ISNULL(FP.START_TIME_MI, '073') AS START_TIME_MI, ISNULL(FP.LOCAL_HH23MI, '073') AS LOCAL_HH23MI -- LOCAL 기준 시업시간/분 / -- 조회 시점 LOCAL 시간/분
				, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', ''), 1, 3) AS KSTMI -- 조회 시점 한국 시간/분
		FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL SCP WITH(NOLOCK)

			LEFT JOIN 
			(
					SELECT   SITE_ID, P.PLANT_ID
							, VL.SEGMENT2, SUBSTRING(VL.SEGMENT2,1,3) AS START_TIME_MI -- LOCAL 기준 시업시간/분
							, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), [DBO].[FN_SITE_TIME_SN] (P.SITE_ID), 120),':', ''), 12, 3) AS LOCAL_HH23MI -- 조회 시점 LOCAL 시간/분 : LGCE_FPDEV_TR.[DBO].[FN_SITE_TIME]
							, SUBSTRING(VL.SEGMENT2,1,2) AS START_TIME -- LOCAL 기준 시업시간
							, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), [DBO].[FN_SITE_TIME_SN] (P.SITE_ID), 120),':', ''), 12, 2) AS LOCAL_HH23 -- 조회 시점 LOCAL 시간
					
					FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE_SN  VL WITH(NOLOCK),
							SCM_MST_PLANT_SN         P  WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE  VL.SEGMENT1         = P.PLANT_ID
					AND    VL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT'
					AND    VL.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
			) FP
			ON  SCP.SEGMENT3 = FP.PLANT_ID -- PLANT ID

		WHERE  SCP.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_POSTING_STOCK_SETUP'
        AND    SEGMENT5   <> '-'
		AND    SCP.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
		) A
WHERE  RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(a.START_TIME + 1)),2) = a.LOCAL_HH23 -- I/F 수신후 1시간 후.
ORDER BY 1;

 OPEN PLANT_TEMP;
	FETCH NEXT FROM PLANT_TEMP INTO @V_PLANT_ID, @V_COMPANY_ID, @V_NERP_GUBUN
		 
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
    BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @d_event_date DATE= SYSDATETIME();
	DECLARE @LOGMESSAGE NVARCHAR(500) =  + CONCAT(@V_COMPANY_ID,'/',@V_PLANT_ID)
	EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH 'ERP_GSCM_END_STOCK_D_CHK', 'XIF_ERP_ZMM_GSCM_END_STOCK_R' , 0, @LOGMESSAGE, N'일마감수신_점검' , @d_event_date

       IF NOT EXISTS( 
		   SELECT TOP 10 * FROM XIF_ERP_ZMM_GSCM_END_STOCK_R_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
		   WHERE SPMON = @V_YYYYMM
		   AND TRANSFER_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
		   AND BUKRS =  @V_COMPANY_ID
		   AND WERKS =  @V_PLANT_ID
	   ) AND EXISTS
	   (
		   SELECT TOP 10 * FROM XIF_ERP_ZMM_GSCM_END_STOCK_R_SN WITH(NOLOCK)
		   WHERE SPMON = @V_YYYYMM
		   AND TRANSFER_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE()-1,112)
		   AND BUKRS =  @V_COMPANY_ID
		   AND WERKS =  @V_PLANT_ID		
	   )
	   BEGIN
		SET @MESSAGE = N'END_STOCK_D_CHK ' + CONCAT(@V_COMPANY_ID,'/',@V_PLANT_ID)
		EXEC SCM_ADM_SMS_SEND_BATCH 60, @message
	   END
	   
        FETCH NEXT FROM PLANT_TEMP INTO @V_PLANT_ID, @V_COMPANY_ID, @V_NERP_GUBUN
    END
		
    CLOSE PLANT_TEMP;
    DEALLOCATE PLANT_TEMP;
